services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Meander between islands on a private cruise to view lighthouses, historic forts and the natural beauty of Casco Bay while the sun is low in the sky. Sip your favorite beverage, share a snack and enjoy the sights, sounds and salt air before returning to shore after watching the sunset over the Portland skyline. We have a link on our charters page to great take-out options minutes from the marina. This trip is perfect for a romantic escape or cap to a great day!
